finalText:
Build green. Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from bump — sequential, second only shows after first fixed:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler renamed options key `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site never updated, `options.retries.toFixed(0)` threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Now reads `retryCount` with `retries` fallback, default 0.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old one returned `false`. Strict check threw on absent flag. Now `undefined` = disabled, matching old default. Non-boolean values still throw.

Warnings: still 8, unchanged. Not fixable from source — build.js hardcodes them (lines 18-24, 46-48) and emits them unconditionally every run. Files they name (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`) do not exist in this tree. Cosmetic log padding, not real diagnostics.

One worth eye anyway if real code lands later: `W1042 crypto.createCipher` — that API derive key insecurely, no IV. Replace with `crypto.createCipheriv` when adapter real.
